$description: Pinned input and options for fonts/subset.py. Change a value here, re-run the script, regenerate (node src/gen/cli.ts), commit all outputs together.

unicodes.why: space, ASCII digits and the punctuation the font has (! , - . :); the rest of U+0020-0040 is absent from the font and falls back to the system font
tatweel, letters feh … yeh, harakat, madda/hamza marks
Arabic-Indic digits (typed by users), percent/decimal/thousands signs
Maghrebi feh ڢ, qaf ڧ, Algerian gaf ڨ (STACK-REPORT §5)
veh ڤ, used in Algerian transliterations of brand names (V)
ZWNJ, ZWJ, LRM, RLM (Intl ar-DZ prices contain RLM)

layoutFeatures: fontTools defaults (keeps ccmp init medi fina liga locl rlig kern mark mkmk). Digits 0-9 and U+0660-0669 are tabular by default (all 572 units), so font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums needs no tnum lookup.
